description: Undo and redo for inline edits in the Svelte 5 data grid. Every cell edit goes onto a history stack; Ctrl or Cmd plus Z undoes, Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes, and the same surface is exposed as api.undo(), api.redo(), api.canUndo() and api.canRedo() for toolbar buttons. The history is bounded at 200 steps, and api.clearHistory() resets the baseline after a successful save.

faq.question: Do I need to wire the keyboard shortcuts myself?
faq.answer: No. Ctrl/Cmd+Z, Ctrl/Cmd+Y and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z work as soon as inline editing is on. The API methods exist so you can add buttons with the same behaviour.

faq.question: How do I enable and disable the toolbar buttons?
faq.answer: Read api.canUndo() and api.canRedo() after each change. The demo bumps a counter in onCellValueChange so its $derived button states re-evaluate.

faq.question: When should I call clearHistory?
faq.answer: After the edits have been saved to the server. Clearing makes the saved state the new baseline, so an undo cannot walk back past what is already persisted.
